Partial matching may retain all unmatched jobs as priced exits; nested widths may avoid repeated products of batching denominators.
stop_rule: First prove exact whole-integer matching, chronological return, top sources and smaller exits. Then test whether the complete recurrence supports the desired exponent. Do not infer exponent admission from moment balance. If it fails, preserve the first counterexample or missing lemma and the explicit-size result; no broader census or new kappa claim.
